supporting_observations.claim: User ivy.chen used PowerShell to compress a directory from the file server (\\FILE-NWD-01\Shared\Clients) into a local zip file (C:\Users\ivy.chen\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip)
User ivy.chen navigated to an unapproved file-sharing site (quickshare-drop.net) using Google Chrome
A large outbound transfer of approximately 51 MB was made from WS-ICHEN-01 to quickshare-drop.net via the web proxy
The timing and sequence of activity (compressing server data followed by a large upload to a public drop site) indicates data exfiltration

unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect (vpnui.exe) and Zscaler (ZSATunnel.exe) are present and running on WS-ICHEN-01, which are not listed in the approved software inventory.
